content: Fastify auth pattern: prefer onRequest (or preParsing) hooks over preHandler for header-only credential checks (API key/bearer) since onRequest runs before body parsing, avoiding wasted work/DoS surface on unauthenticated requests. @fastify/bearer-auth demonstrates the standard shape: onRequest hook inspects header, does constant-time compare, sends 401 on failure. A scoped plugin (registered only on the Event/Contacts API routes) keeps this hook from applying to session-cookie routes.
